resources.string: Stored on this device. No Fitness Hub account required.
Review height, age and the inputs used for local body estimates.
These are the existing local profile values. Connecting a scale is optional.
Saving updates local estimates from scale measurements. Original measurements stay unchanged. These formulas are not a medical assessment.
Supported height: more than 100 and up to 300 cm. Decimal comma or point accepted.
Age supported by the existing estimate formulas: 10–120 years.
Sex used by the estimate formulas
Check height and age, then select a sex for the formulas.
